name: Huldah
bio: Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum, keeper of the wardrobe, lived in Jerusalem. When King Josiah's officials Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asahiah came to her about the newly found book of the law, she delivered the LORD's word: disaster would come on Jerusalem for its idolatry, exactly as the book warned, but because Josiah's heart had been tender and he had humbled himself in grief, he himself would die in peace and not live to see that disaster (2 Kings 22:14-20).
